source: Native SVG geometry authored from the approved visual family; no bitmap cropping or external icon pack.
rules: Text, counts and fill ratio remain native; no baked numbers.
Clip bar_fill from the left using the actual ratio; do not scale the whole silhouette.
Only one timing bar per unit; health is separate; shield is the right-hand health extension with an exact numeric amount.
Purple absorption is team-wide, not personal.
SVG import_scale 1 (Godot default); linear filtering; no mipmaps; preserve alpha.

Delivered StyleBoxTexture resources reference native-scale SVG, so texture and content margins use the listed logical pixels. Supplied 2x PNG is for explicit destination-rectangle drawing, not a drop-in replacement inside these styles.
intent_focus and stock_focus are independently tinted overlays.

feedback.reduced_motion: Static state changes only; no position/scale animation.

bounds: Assets and native-scale review only. No gameplay widget replacement, no runtime manifest update, no player save change.
